name: cs2-modding
description: Teach your coding agent to write Cities: Skylines II code mods (Claude Code, Codex CLI): a working loop that checks the result in the running game, and the traps an agent with the decompiled game open still falls into. Ships the cs2-dev MCP server, which restarts, stops and awaits the game, reports its errors, and runs a mod's in-game scenarios.
